802d9f2e-2e77-4b0f-bad5-168929194099.message: Hello! My name is Luna. I am calling on behalf of Microware. This call is in regards to our in house survey on Covid. May I ask you a few questions?
Overall, how would you describe your health in the past few days?
Have you experienced any new or ongoing symptoms such as pain, fatigue, dizziness, or discomfort?
Are you able to carry out your daily activities, such as work or household tasks, without difficulty?
Have you noticed any recent changes in your weight, appetite, or sleep pattern?
